ns2:course.label: Readings in Basque Studies
ns2:course.description: Directed research providing individualized instruction on specific topics in Basque linguistics and culture. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. May be repeated to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: BASQ 401 or consent of instructor.
